description: This Kotlin source file defines the DeviceHandler class, which provides methods to retrieve device status, info, permissions, and health data on Android devices. It includes private helper functions for collecting battery, storage, network, and system information, as well as for permission checks and mapping system states to human-readable forms.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class for managing device status, info, permissions, and health on Android devices. It encapsulates logic for reading system states and formatting them as JSON payloads.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Data class representing a snapshot of battery parameters including status, plugged status, level, and temperature.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns device status information including battery, thermal, storage, and network states as a JSON string.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns device identity and environment information such as device model, system version, and locale.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Provides current permission statuses for various device features, including sensors, storage, and communication.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Returns system health metrics including memory and battery status, power modes, and security patch level.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Internal method that constructs a JSON string with current battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime data.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with device identity information, build details, and locale.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Builds a JSON string detailing current permissions and access statuses for various features.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON string with system health data, including memory pressure, battery charge, power state, and security patch level.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Reads current battery parameters and returns a BatterySnapshot object.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates battery level as a fraction based on intent data.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Maps battery status codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Maps charging plug type codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Maps thermal status codes to human-readable system health states.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Converts network capability info into a descriptive network status string.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Helper to generate JSON representation of permission grant status and promptability.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has a specific system permission.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure state based on total and available bytes, and low memory flag.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON array listing known network transports (wifi, cellular, wired).
